# StatsPAI

> Agent-native causal inference and applied econometrics in Python: one `import statspai as sp` over 1,100+ functions (DiD, RD, IV, synthetic control, DML, meta-learners, matching, panel, spatial, time series, survival, decomposition), numerically aligned with Stata / R reference implementations, with self-describing schemas, structured results and Word / Excel / LaTeX export.

Install: `pip install statspai` (`pip install "statspai[fixest,plotting]"` for high-dimensional fixed effects and figures). MCP server: `statspai-mcp`. CLI: `statspai`.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an agent discovers, calls and reads StatsPAI (discover → describe → call, the result contract, the rules to keep)
- [Agent API guide](docs/guides/agent_api.md): the 12-piece agent surface, token-budget control, `sp.audit`, citations, MCP server, shell `statspai run`
- [MCP workflow for economists](docs/guides/economist_mcp_workflow.md): data handoff (`data_path` / `data_id` / inline), result handles, the detect → estimate → audit loop, Stata / R migration
- [README](README.md): overview, install, quick start (English; `README_CN.md` is the Chinese edition)

## Start from a task (tested code on real data, Stata / R equivalents)

- [Difference-in-differences in Python](docs/tasks/difference-in-differences.md): TWFE, Goodman-Bacon decomposition, Callaway-Sant'Anna, event study
- [Fixed effects and HDFE](docs/tasks/fixed-effects.md): `reghdfe` / `fixest` equivalent with clustered SEs
- [Instrumental variables and 2SLS](docs/tasks/iv-2sls.md): first-stage F, Anderson-Rubin interval
- [Regression discontinuity](docs/tasks/regression-discontinuity.md): rdrobust-style bias-corrected inference, density test
- [Regression tables](docs/tasks/regression-tables.md): Word / Excel / LaTeX export (`esttab` / `outreg2` equivalent)
- [From Stata to Python](docs/tasks/stata-to-python.md): command map, `sp.stata`, `sp.from_stata`
- [Choosing a Python econometrics library](docs/tasks/python-econometrics-libraries.md): capability matrix checked against each library's docs
- [AI agents and MCP](docs/tasks/ai-agents-mcp.md): Claude Code / Cursor setup, `statspai mcp doctor`, compatibility table
- [Claims and evidence](docs/claims-and-evidence.md): every public claim and the command that re-checks it

## Machine-readable

- [schemas/functions.json](schemas/functions.json): JSON-Schema for every registered function
- [schemas/tools.json](schemas/tools.json): MCP / tool-use manifest
- [schemas/agent_cards.json](schemas/agent_cards.json): assumptions, pre-conditions, failure modes, alternatives per function
- [schemas/result.schema.json](schemas/result.schema.json): the result envelope
- [docs/parity.md](docs/parity.md): numerical evidence index (R / Stata parity per module)
